description: This file defines a functional interface named DisconnectListener which is intended to be implemented as a callback for handling unexpected disconnections in a Hono client connection.

classes.name: DisconnectListener
classes.description: A functional interface for receiving notifications when a connection to a Hono service is lost unexpectedly. It is generic over the connection type T and contains a single method onDisconnect.

methods.name: onDisconnect
methods.description: Method invoked when the connection to a Hono service is lost unexpectedly. It receives the client instance representing the connection.
